title: GoldenWorkflowCoverage
description: Records which Golden Workflow stages an Interconnected Systems Stability Engineer investigation covered for a given task, and why any stage was skipped. Consumed by mold-commit-ready, which must refuse a Ready verdict if any stage is SKIPPED-UNJUSTIFIED. See docs/agent-skills/interconnected-systems-stability/SKILL.md for the full procedure this record supports. This is the only machine-readable schema this skill introduces in Phase 1 — dependency-map, state-ownership-map, protected-contract, and system-impact-report artifacts were deliberately deferred (see the approved Engineering Proposal, section 17).

taskDescription.description: The change this coverage record was produced for, verbatim or closely paraphrased.

coverageScope.description: FULL_WORKFLOW_REQUIRED when the change affects shared lifecycle, model replacement, runtime ownership, transform synchronization, or pipeline coordination, or otherwise carries broad regression risk. SUBSET_JUSTIFIED for a narrow change confined to one stage plus its immediate downstream consumer.

coverageScopeReason.description: One-line justification for the coverageScope decision.

stages.description: One entry per Golden Workflow stage. Remove Mold and Rebuild are explicitly unverified as distinct actions in this codebase as of Phase 1 (see SKILL.md) - a coverage record may mark them SKIPPED-JUSTIFIED with reason 'stage existence unverified, out of Phase 1 scope' but must not claim RUN for either without independent verification performed outside this skill.

reason.description: Required (non-null) when status is not RUN.

evidence.description: File:line, test name, or manual verification note supporting a RUN status.

blockers.description: Non-empty whenever any stage is SKIPPED-UNJUSTIFIED - each such stage must produce one entry here, consumed the same way as the Regression Risk Synthesizer's Blockers category in SKILL.md.
